# SabiLearn

> SabiLearn (https://sabilearn.online) is a premier Nigerian EdTech platform offering practical tech courses, interactive coding exercises, checkpoint quizzes, and AI-powered study tools (Lecture Summarizer, Quiz Generator, Flashcards Generator, Q&A Study Assistant).

## Key Public Pages

- [Home](https://sabilearn.online/): Overview of SabiLearn's course catalog, AI study suite, interactive lessons, and pricing.
- [Blog](https://sabilearn.online/blog): Practical study guides, learning science, exam techniques, and technology tutorials.
- [Terms of Service](https://sabilearn.online/terms): Service terms, course access policies, and AI usage rules.
- [Privacy Policy](https://sabilearn.online/privacy): Data privacy, collection policies, and learner safety.

## Pricing Structure (in Nigerian Naira ₦)

- **Free Plan**: ₦0 forever — foundational courses, interactive quizzes, and daily AI tokens.
- **Single Course**: ₦2,500 (one-time payment) — lifetime access to a specific course, capstone projects, and certificate of completion.
- **All-Access Pass**: ₦3,000/month or ₦30,000/year (with 2 months free) — unlimited access to all courses, unlimited AI study tools, and verified certificates.
- Payment methods supported: Nigerian Debit Cards (Mastercard, Visa, Verve), Bank Transfer, and USSD.

## AI Study Tools Capabilities

- **Lecture Summarizer**: Extracts core concepts, key formulas, and exam takeaways from long lecture notes and documents.
- **AI Quiz Generator**: Generates customized multiple-choice practice quizzes with explanations from notes or topics.
- **Flashcards Generator**: Creates spaced repetition flashcards for rapid revision.
- **Q&A AI Tutor**: Interactive step-by-step homework and study assistant.

## Developer & Company Information

- Built and maintained by [Codiac](https://www.codiac.online).
- Made in Nigeria for African and global learners.
